 assignees:

+comments:
+- actor: claude-code
+  id: 01m8cefyn01e4j5mc6cd2e991k
+  text: |-
+    Research:
+    - Both families already inherit `TensorParallelShardable` from `Qwen35Model` (`Qwen35MoEModel` and `PrismHadamardQwen35Model` subclass it). The plan throws for MoE (`Qwen35TensorParallelPlan.init`, `denseMLP()`), and `TensorParallel.requireStockProjection` rejects `HadamardQuantizedLinear`.
+    - Inkling2's MoE scheme is per-expert tensor parallel: split the inner width of every expert (gate/up rows, down inputs, through `TensorParallel.shardAxes` on the expert tensors), and one `allSum` over the weighted expert sum (`Inkling2MoE.adoptShardedExperts(group:)`). The router stays whole. Qwen3.5 MoE reuses this: switch_mlp gate/up axis 1, down axis 2; shared expert gate/up rows and down inputs in place; one allSum over routed + gated shared output (the shared gate is a per-token scalar, so the sum is linear).
+    - Hadamard: `y = W·R(x)`, `R` block diagonal (block b) with a sign flip per input. A row split keeps the rotation whole (signs whole). An input split is correct per shard when each shard's input run holds whole blocks: shard r keeps `signs[r]` and the matching columns. Rotated layers pass the fusion and fast paths by exact-type checks, so a subclass falls back to callAsFunction.
+    - Existing harnesses: in-process share-sum (Inkling2ShareSumTests, each rank's share computed in one process, partials summed), group-of-one logits tests, and scripts/shard-check.sh (2 ring processes on localhost vs unsharded logits; the dense Qwen35 logits check). No in-process multi-rank group exists (MLX caches one group per backend per process).

+- actor: claude-code
+  id: 01m8cg09gp9jn2mcg9wq3310q2
+  text: |-
+    Implementation landed.
+    - MoE (per-expert tensor parallel, same scheme as Inkling 2): `Qwen35TensorParallelPlan` no longer refuses MoE. It checks `moeIntermediateSize` and `sharedExpertIntermediateSize` for MoE models and `intermediateSize` for dense ones. `Qwen35TensorParallelPlan.expertSplits` splits switch_mlp gate/up rows (axis 1), down inputs (axis 2), and the shared expert gate/up rows and down inputs (axis 1), all in place. The router and shared_expert_gate stay whole. `Qwen35SparseMoeBlock.adoptShardedExperts(group:)` does one allSum over routed plus gated shared output. New generic helpers in MLXLMCommon: `TensorParallel.switchGLUSplits`, `requireStockExperts` (stock SwitchGLU / SwitchLinear / QuantizedSwitchLinear, no down bias), and `requireWholeExpertShares` (whole rows, whole quantization groups).
+    - Hadamard: `requireStockProjection` accepts exact `HadamardQuantizedLinear`. `requireWholeInputs(of:)` also requires whole Hadamard blocks per process. `makeShardedToAll` builds the new `ShardedToAllHadamardQuantizedLinear`, which keeps its own sign slice and columns, calls allSum, and adds the bias once. `shardAxes` keeps the signs of row-split rotated projections whole (`wholeRotationSigns`) and throws `.unsupported` for an in-place input split of a rotated projection.
+    - `shardableModelFamilies` adds `prism_hadamard_qwen35`, `qwen3_5_moe` and `qwen3_8_moe`. The LLM factory maps qwen3_8_moe to the same `Qwen35MoEModel`, so it shards too, and the docs that listed it as refused would otherwise be wrong. The family test now also calls `shard(group:)` on a group of one, besides checking the conformance. DocC distributed-inference.md and the skill references are updated.
+    - Tests (MLXLMTests): Qwen35MoETensorParallelTests (plan, splits, mxfp4 whole shares, down-bias refusal, float and 4-bit share-sum of a block, group-of-one decode and logits), HadamardTensorParallelTests (per-rank `partialProduct` share-sum vs whole, group of one, split block refused, row split keeps signs, in-place input split refused, every prism pack layer makes shards). Shared helper `TensorParallelShares.keep` in MLXLMTestSupport (Inkling2ShareSumTests now uses it). The obsolete "MoE is not supported" plan test is removed.
+    - Sharded-vs-local logits, 2 ring processes on localhost (scripts/shard-check.sh), on tiny random checkpoints written by a throwaway test (not committed; follow-up ^727pxfp). qwen3_5_moe (4-bit, 8 experts) and prism_hadamard_qwen35 (4-bit rotated, blocks 32/64/128): teacher-forced PASS 9/9 agree, max abs logit diff ≤ 1e-4; --announce PASS for both. Mutations: rank-0 signs on every shard failed prism 9/9 steps, and dropping the MoE allSum failed MoE 9/9. Unit mutations (MoE throw, wrong shared-down axis, down-bias guard, rank-0 signs) each failed their tests.
+    - Interesting: the load-peak gate reads 0.00 GiB for MB-sized checkpoints, so it says nothing at that size.
